title: Upgrading to Ultra was the biggest mistake I ever made
author: NeverLucky159
selftext:
So I spent weeks working on a project, few days ago I decided to progress faster with many images and assets prepared ready to go and I upgraded to Ultra. I also subscribed to many services such as fal, meshy etc. so Claude can work fast on everything 

But Claude triggered verification and even though I did it correctly with even lighting, no reflections, clear ID and selfie etc. it did not grant me the verification. I never had issue with verification before in my whole life so definitely the issue is on their side.

There is no human contact to talk to, only bots or forms which I filled and talked to their chat bot support which said they will contact me on email. However it has been days and no response and I have read threads from other people saying it takes around 3 months to get a repsponse, if ever.

So now I'm stuck with all the services running and no use for them. Also I already have my Claude subscription running but can't use it. 

The worst thing is the time wasted honestly.

comments.author: TrashPocketz
comments.body: What do you mean by “triggered verification”?

replies.author: NeverLucky159
replies.body: It suddenly says I need to get verified in order to keep using Claude. It doesn't let me use it anymore, even though they charged me.. This is technically fraud - they charged me but don't let me use their service

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body:
It's not fraud, you agreed to their terms when you started using it. One of them surely includes identity verification.

Is the other commenter correct, are you too young to use claude?

replies.author: NeverLucky159
replies.body: I did not break any terms and I'm not too young to use their product. If they don't let me use it they should give me my money back otherwise it is fraud, especially since there is no explanation and no support

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: What happened when you went through verification? did the process fail or did the verification go through and they decided they don't want you?

replies.author: CauseQueasy8023
replies.body: Where are you from? There has been a surge of region blockages for people and organisations in CIS, hong kong, mainland china, some other SEA locations.

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body:
You've had a pretty nice life if that's the biggest mistake you've ever made.

Did they give a reason?

There's no reason you can't still use all of those other services.

replies.author: NeverLucky159
replies.body: They did not give any reason or explanation. I bought the highest tier of the other services because I was counting on using them automatically with Claude.There is no way for me to use even 10% of it manually

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: Any number of other AI products can connect to MCP servers and use them. Anthropic is not the only game in town.

replies.author: NeverLucky159
replies.body: Yeah but it seems the best by far.. In terms of quality

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: It is, but only at the moment.

comments.author: Wide-Bobcat-3723
comments.body:
Just move on bro. I've been waiting since Oct 24th with 0 responses. 

Luckily I use Codex, Gemini, & Claude all equally with $100 plans and everything is in github so I was able to pick up my project with no issues. 

I regret convincing my boss to use Anthropic for our company because now I'm terrified of tripping up safety measures there too.

replies.author: NeverLucky159
replies.body: How can you use Claude with a $100 plan without using  Anthropic? I need to use it on desktop though with mcp access etc

replies.author: Wide-Bobcat-3723
replies.body:
That’s what I had before I was blocked from my personal Claude account. You can use Opus5.5 (with very limited usage) in Antigravity.

I still have my work claude account that I keep very sterile now (even though I work in cybersecurity).
